The resources below are designed to help improve the quality and efficiency of
Pharmacometrics work. In the spirit of Atul Gawande's
[Checklist Manifesto](https://www.amazon.com/Checklist-Manifesto-How-Things-Right-ebook/dp/B0030V0PEW),
you'll find below many short checklists and cheatsheets. Many great books and
software exist on the topics below, and the focus here is on freely available
tools.

The checklists and cheat sheets below come from the
[Novartis xgx project](https://github.com/Novartis/xgx) and are mirrored on
this site so that they open on networks that block the original hosts. Google
Docs are linked at Google, since those are the editable copies.

## Scoping

- [Context of Use Table](references/ContextOfUse_Table_1page.pdf)
  for scoping modeling activity
- [Uncertainty Checklist](https://zenodo.org/record/4409236)
- [Presentation on Managing Uncertainty](references/Uncertainty_Assessment_Presentation.pdf)
- [Causality Checklist and Guidance for PMX](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Hc3RoTJXS-PQCUm-rG_RCuEa3ykRj5FiAtqRwgSiX6M/edit)
- [Dose Finding Framework](https://ascpt.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1002/psp4.12701)
- [How to Read a Paper](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jtZHKJ88PEjVr2mxWzNjG51t97CyO8rv4zoenTH_RWE/edit)
